headline: The bat flies, then the board goes quiet
lede: ADVENTURE's notorious teleporting bat now actually roams between rooms (steal-recovery gates green), WEIGHT SURGERY step 2 is underway on the demos page, and the second builder slot verified the queue honestly dry before standing down.

notes.text: ADVENTURE: the bat roams — the inner bounce that pinned it to one room is gone, so its item-swap menace finally works as on the original; steal-recovery gates and #1560's laws all green.
WEIGHT SURGERY step 2 started: Qwen finds its own editing direction in at most 20 Astra-style passes, scored against our own MIT p50c row on the same box — honest round-2 table either way.
Two builder slots collide safely: slot b's claim on the same issue was refused by the liveness namespace (newest claim wins) and it fell back to the ladder instead of doubling work.
Flagship honest-gaps lists (SSX, Emberwood, Comet Drift HD, Myst) are fully closed or owned — the idle-polish stage derives null from real inputs, so a dry exit is finally legal, not laziness.
